info.title: WindScope UK API
info.description:
Day-ahead **wind forecast analytics** for GB power procurement (Elexon FUELHH / WINDFOR, national WIND only).

* Every KPI uses the forecast **available at the day-ahead decision cutoff** - never later revisions.
* Signed error is `forecast - actual` (positive = over-forecast).
* Metrics that cannot be defined are `null` ("unavailable"), never zero.
* Wind forecast error is **not** the utility's net procurement requirement.

get.description: Always 200 while the process is up; `data_loaded` says whether a snapshot is being served.

Everything the UI needs to describe its data honestly: source, retrieval time, refresh outcome,
permitted date windows, cutoff presets, data-quality report and thresholds. Works with no dataset loaded.

post.summary: Re-ingest from Elexon (disabled unless ADMIN_TOKEN is set)
post.description:
Runs a full ingestion. On failure the previous snapshot keeps being served and the failure is
recorded in `/api/metadata`.

get.description:
Headline accuracy metrics, coverage, data-sufficiency status and baseline comparison.

All KPIs use the forecast that was **available at the decision cutoff** (latest publication with
`publishTime <= cutoff`). Later revisions appear only under `hindsight_latest`, for context.

cutoff_local.title: Cutoff Local
cutoff_local.description: Decision cutoff, 24h HH:MM, Europe/London, on the day before delivery.

forecast_block_minutes.title: Forecast Block Minutes
forecast_block_minutes.description: Span covered by one WINDFOR value: 60 for the hourly feed under 'hold', else 30.

forecast_alignment.title: Forecast Alignment
forecast_alignment.description: 'hold' applies each forecast hour to both half-hours it covers; 'exact' only matches identical start times.

forecast_alignment_note.title: Forecast Alignment Note
forecast_alignment_note.description: How forecasts were mapped onto half-hours; null when the grids already coincide.

AnalysisEcho.title: AnalysisEcho
AnalysisEcho.description: The exact interpretation a response was computed under (never mixed across bases).

n.title: N
n.description: Intervals where forecast, actual and this baseline are all available.

skill.title: Skill
skill.description: 1 - MAE_forecast / MAE_baseline. Positive = forecast is better.

energy_mwh.title: Energy Mwh
energy_mwh.description: Sum of forecast MW x 0.5 h over intervals with a forecast.

HindsightOut.title: HindsightOut
HindsightOut.description: Latest-published forecast (includes revisions after the cutoff). Context only - never used in KPIs.

forecast_alignment.title: Forecast Alignment
forecast_alignment.description: How hourly forecasts are mapped onto half-hourly actuals (server setting).

n.title: N
n.description: Number of valid matched half-hourly observations.

wape.title: Wape
wape.description: Sum|error| / Sum(actual); null when not meaningful.

is_synthetic.title: Is Synthetic
is_synthetic.description: True only for the development fixture; never for Elexon data.

retrieved_at.title: Retrieved At
retrieved_at.description: When the snapshot was last successfully retrieved (UTC).

settlement_period.title: Settlement Period
settlement_period.description: Settlement period on a standard 48-period day.

minutes_from_cutoff.title: Minutes From Cutoff
minutes_from_cutoff.description: Publication minus cutoff; negative = before the cutoff.

selected.title: Selected
selected.description: The latest eligible publication - the one used in all KPIs.

forecast_for_time.title: Forecast For Time
forecast_for_time.description: Start of the WINDFOR block this half-hour's forecast refers to (equals start_time unless forecasts are hourly).

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.description: Set when the comparison cannot be shown in full, and why.
